Before you scan

PaddleX reads labels on this local server. OCR can work without internet; Bhashini Hindi and Azure English narration use internet services. Photos are sent only to the configured OCR service.

We read: MRP, FSSAI licence, nutrition, allergens, dates, ingredients and manufacturer details.
